data.action: 坐于书桌旋转椅双腿微并，轻捏睡衣领口脸红凝视
data.animaCaption: Seated in a desk chair beside a warm bedside lamp in her dormitory room, her crimson-piped ivory silk pajama shirt is unbuttoned at the collar as she looks over with rosy cheeks.
data.description: 深夜学生宿舍暖黄台灯下，千咲穿着绯红滚边象牙白真丝睡衣衬衫，纽扣解开几颗露出白皙锁骨与修长双腿，坐在椅上害羞低头。
data.lighting: 书桌护眼台灯暖黄聚光与窗外深蓝夜色
data.location: 星炬学院宿舍深夜书桌旁
data.promptProse: In the warm pool of light from her dormitory desk lamp, Chisa sits in a crimson-piped ivory silk pajama shirt worn loosely unbuttoned at the neck, blushing softly as she meets your eyes.
data.title: 千咲 · 宿舍书桌台灯下象牙白真丝睡衣微敞
